title.en: An Act Authorizing the Payment of Per Diems to Any Constabulary Officer Who May Be Designated as Aide-De-Camp to the Governor-General.

text.en:
There is hereby authorized to be paid out of the current appropriation for the Executive Bureau,
per diem not to exceed ten pesos to any officer of the Philippine Constabulary who may be designated by the
Governor-General as aide-de-camp to the Governor-General, such per diem to be in addition to the regular
compensation of such officer.

This Act shall take effect as of February eighteenth, nineteen hundred and fourteen.
Enacted, February 28, 1914.
